claire: T-10m before the maintenance window. Need final confirmation: ben on pin/unpin, I'll coordinate. Quick checklist: preflight ok, canary region = us-east-1, bake 12m. @ben
ben: Confirmed. I will pin redwood-api@dedicated after canary. Rollback owner I am.
deploy-bot: Preflight OK: migrations noop, image digests match in primary region. Scheduled canary 2823456789-canary -> us-east-1 @5%.
sre-bot: Alerts armed: p95 > 200ms OR error-rate > 1% will page. Also tracking token/sec cost.
claire: If we see cost spike only, preferred mitigation: reduce batch size 50% for canary. Ben, have script?
ben: `scripts/adjust_batch.sh redwood-api 0.5` ready.
claire: Rollback commands for quick copy:
```
# abort rollout
deploy-bot abort --id 2823456789-canary
# rollback to stable
deploy-bot rollback --service redwood-api --to stable-299
```
deploy-bot: Canary live @5%. Bake timer started.
06:05:30Z ben: smoke-1: 50/50 pass, 1 retry success, embeddings diff 0.3%.
sre-bot: p95=175ms, error-rate=0.2%, cost=1.04x baseline.
claire: Hold for second smoke. Ben, paste results and we'll decide expand or hold.
06:12:10Z ben: smoke-2: 200/200 pass. No regressions. Proceed to expand to 25% in us-east-only.
deploy-bot: Expansion command executed. 25% live.
sre-bot: Monitoring: p95=185ms, error-rate=0.25%, cost=1.06x. No pages.
claire: Good. Please keep unpin schedule to +1h if stable. This thread is the source of truth for the window. Locking after post-pin notes. :lock:
